text:
ana: kicking off EU1 minor release v2026.3.1 -> canary (eu-west1). deploy-bot started at 03:15 UTC. quick smoke plan: synth x20 + health probes x3 over 4m.
deploy-bot: Job ignite-canary-3279998888 started. image: redwood/inference:2026.3.1-canary. pods 3 -> 3. rolling traffic 5% by default.
jorge: running synth now. focused on short prompt latencies + tokenization boundary tests.
infra_tom: FYI I've got a pre-warmed snapshot ready if tokenizer issues show up.
jorge: synth 20/20 responses returned but 2/20 show "malformed-tokens" in response metadata. sample:
```json
{ "status": 200, "route": "/v1/generate", "meta": { "token_errors": ["malformed-tokens"] } }
```
oncall-bot: Alert: synth-token-errors threshold exceeded (>=2)  created incident INC-2026-204.
nana: hmm. malformed tokens could indicate tokenizer merge table mismatch with compiled model. options: 1) pin to previous stable image 2) run a targeted hotfix build (patch token table) and redeploy 3) continue and monitor (risk).
jorge: logs show tokenizer version header "tokenizer_v3.4" on canary vs "tokenizer_v3.3" in stable. suspect packaging error. hotfix build is fast (~4-6m) but we'd need to hold rollout.
infra_tom: I can push a reposync that swaps tokenizer binary in the image and trigger a rolling restart in canary namespace. command I'd run:
```
kubectl set image deployment/ignite-canary redwood=inference:2026.3.1-hotfix-tokenizer --namespace=canary
```
nana: prefer hotfix if it's quick. set hold window. If hotfix not ready in 8m, roll back. oncall-bot, set rollback timer 8m.
oncall-bot: Rollback timer set for +8m.
deploy-bot: ramp to 0% until hold cleared. build system: starting hotfix build (id: hfix-3279998888).
jorge: hotfix build completed, unit tests for tokenizer pass. triggering canary image update now.
deploy-bot: image updated -> restarting pods (3). health probes starting.
jorge: re-running synth x20: 20/20, no token errors. p95 latency unchanged. looks good.
nana: lift hold, schedule gradual ramp: 10% -> 30% after 10m -> full after 30m if stable. update release_notes: "tokenizer mismatch hotfix applied to canary; synth green".
infra_tom: adding runbook entry: if tokenizer header mismatch detected, auto-abort and build hotfix. created PR #5402 for automating detection.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-204 resolved (tokenizer hotfix applied).
nana: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with postdeploy graphs in the verification doc and mark the change window as extended by 15m.
